# 1Password

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 2 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Password/security product marketing: announcement strip + white nav chrome, navy gradient hero, segment-selector plan pill, pricing columns, FAQ accordions.

Captured 2026-11-08, signed out (the vault is credential-gated and was never reached). Themes: light.

The public face of [1password.com](https://1password.com): the marketing home, pricing, product, download, developer and contact-sales pages, plus the edge of the sign-in surface, read as a design system. 44 components in 97 measured states, 97 crops, 19 screenshots, 113 tokens. The vault itself is credential-gated (account + secret key + master password) and was never reached — everything here is the public site, and the gaps below say exactly where the evidence stops.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- **The vault.** Nothing behind `my.1password.com`/`start.1password.com` was reached; the app needs credentials this capture does not have. The unsupported-browser page is the honest boundary. Do not read app functionality into this package — it is a marketing-site system.
- **Cross-origin embeds.** The Vimeo player (`video-embed`) and the Marketo sales form (`form-embed`) are measured as element boxes only; their contents are unreachable and nothing inside them is claimed.
- **The consent card.** The OneTrust "We use cookies" card renders in a closed shadow root; it is suppressed for captures (seeded consent cookie + a geometric sweep), so it has no measurements — it is chrome of the consent vendor, not of the design system.
- **`--knox-*` variables that resolve to nothing.** Some Knox names (e.g. button hover/pressed fills) are unset on this site; only resolved values made it into tokens.
- **Quantised screenshots.** `screenshots/` are 256-colour PNGs; read exact colours from tokens or `raw/full/`.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Do** treat `tokens.json` as truth: Knox roles (secure-blue #0364d3, midnight-navy #1a2860, ink #303136) and the 90px pill profile are the site's own tokens.
- **Do** read hover/focus/pressed diffs in `components.md` for interaction behaviour.
- **Don't** infer vault UI, auth flows or app functionality from these pages — they were never captured.
- **Don't** trust colours inside `screenshots/` PNGs for exact values (256-colour quantised); use tokens.
- **Don't** treat the Marketo iframe or Vimeo player internals as measured — they are documented boundaries.
